title: matrix-matrix multiplication

atoms.evidence: as_strided_mm(matA, matB) — implements torch.matmul for 2D-by-2D from scratch
sA0, sA1 = matA.stride(); sB0, sB1 = matB.stride() — pulls strides from both inputs
matA_expanded = matA.as_strided(expanded_size, (sA0, sA1, 0)); matB_expanded = matB.as_strided(expanded_size, (0, sB0, sB1))
stride 0 in last dim of A and first dim of B — A is broadcast over k-axis, B is broadcast over i-axis; classic ij,jk -> ijk expansion via strides
(matA_expanded * matB_expanded).sum(dim=1) — elementwise multiply of two (i, j, k) tensors; the broadcast was set up manually

notes: 5-atom mirror of 0_2_15 but for full matmul. Together with 0_2_15, validates that matvec and matmul-2d are not redundant atoms — they share strided-broadcast machinery but the contraction shape and the i,j,k expansion are subtly different (matvec needs one broadcast, matmul needs two). Worth keeping both atoms.
